  COUNT(*) as total_plants,
  SUM(CASE WHEN wikidata_qid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_qid,
  SUM(CASE WHEN pubchem_cid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_pubchem,
  SUM(CASE WHEN gbif_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_gbif,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chebi_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_chebi
FROM plants;
